myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Themis appears in greek tradition as divine law, order, custom. The name's meaning, "A Titaness, the personification of divine order, law, and established custom; a consort of Zeus and mother of the Seasons (Horae) and the Fates (Moirai).", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Themis in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Themis remains a touchstone for understanding greek religion, art, and identity.
